final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.type), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.type, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_ratio - s2.overall FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall IS NOT NULL
